title: The Tutorial Is Already Running
overview: Manabe Hibiki suddenly finds himself in an isekai. After finally getting out of a maze, he meets Emalia.

title: I'd Advise Against Solo Combat
overview: When the Tutorial skill levels up, Hibiki loses his "Guide." But he slowly learns how to do things on his own.

title: This Is Unprecedented
overview: Hibiki gains two companions, Claude and Lillian. And apparently the Tutorial skill is incredibly good.

title: Training Is the Only Way
overview: Vene teaches Hibiki and Lillian the basics of magic. After ages, Hibiki manages to learn... a cleaning spell.

title: That Looks Absurdly Good on You
overview: Hibiki puts on girls clothes and looks really good in them. But he is doing that just to catch a thief!

title: I Recommend Using Summon Sacred Beast
overview: Ivell sends Hibiki's party deeper into the woods, and Hibiki gets mortally wounded. Can't anyone help?!

title: Please Adhere to the Usage Instructions When Using It
overview: Sapo-chan announces that Enlightened Mode of the Expert Eye is activated, but how can it help Claude?

title: Today's Temperature Is 39 Degrees
overview: It's so hot that everyone is suffering, especially Claude. Hibiki sets out to find a way to cool them down.

title: Acquired Master of Walking Into Traps
overview: Hibiki and party join Fauna in trying to vanquish an endless undead horde to save a village.

title: I Cannot Answer That Kind of Question
overview: The party made it to the northern dungeon. But right before they enter they're talking about... underpants?

title: This Just Barely Isn't Cheating
overview: Hibiki finds out that he can actually copy/paste rented skills and questions if that's not cheating.

title: The Connection Isn't Severed
overview: Hibiki is all alone and has to face Ivell who is out for blood. She even reduces all his levels down to 1...
